text: the stone which the builders rejected
blank: Did you never read in the Scriptures, 'The stone which the builders ___ was made the head of the corner
gloss: 被輕視者後來成為關鍵支柱
usage: 現代英語常引用 the stone the builders rejected 比喻被忽視或輕視的人事物後來成為重要基石

text: to Caesar the things that are Caesar's
blank: Give therefore to ___ the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's
usage: 現代英語常引用 render unto Caesar what is Caesar's 比喻各自履行本分或義務，常見於政治與稅務評論

blank: You shall ___ your neighbor as yourself
usage: 現代英語廣泛引用 love your neighbor as yourself 作為待人接物的黃金準則

blank: they themselves will not ___ a finger to help them
gloss: 略施舉手之勞（常用於否定句）
usage: 現代英語常用 not lift a finger 形容完全不願提供絲毫幫助

text: strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel
blank: who strain out a gnat, and ___ a camel
usage: 現代英語常引用 strain at a gnat and swallow a camel 形容拘泥小節卻忽略重大問題

blank: you are like ___ tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful
gloss: 外表美麗內裡腐敗，虛有其表
usage: 現代英語仍偶爾引用 whitewashed tombs 形容表面光鮮但內在腐敗虛偽的人事物

blank: you will hear of wars and ___ of wars
gloss: 戰爭與紛擾傳聞，社會動盪不安的徵兆
usage: 現代英語新聞評論仍常引用 wars and rumors of wars 形容社會動盪不安的氛圍

blank: all these things are the beginning of birth ___
gloss: 陣痛，喻劇變開始前的痛苦階段
usage: 現代英語常用 birth pangs 比喻新事物誕生前的痛苦過渡期，常見於政治、社會評論

text: the love of many will grow cold
blank: the love of many will grow ___
usage: 現代英語常用 grow cold 形容感情逐漸冷淡疏離

text: Well done, good and faithful servant
blank: '___, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things'
usage: 現代英語常引用 well done, good and faithful servant 稱讚某人忠誠盡責，常見於悼詞或表揚場合

text: hid your talent in the earth
blank: went away and ___ your talent in the earth
usage: 現代英語常用 bury your talent(s) 比喻埋沒才能、不加善用

text: separates the sheep from the goats
blank: as a shepherd ___ the sheep from the goats
usage: 現代英語常用 separate the sheep from the goats 比喻篩選出優秀者與不合格者

text: one of the least of these
blank: because you did it to ___ of these my brothers
gloss: 最卑微弱小的人，社會底層
usage: 現代英語（尤其慈善與社會正義語境）常引用 the least of these 指稱社會中最弱勢、最容易被忽略的人

blank: they weighed out for him ___ pieces of silver
gloss: 背叛的代價，出賣他人所得的報酬
usage: 現代英語常用 thirty pieces of silver 比喻出賣朋友或原則所得的骯髒報酬，常見於政治評論

text: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak
blank: the spirit indeed is willing, but the ___ is weak
usage: 現代英語非常常用 the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak 形容有心卻力不從心，常帶自嘲幽默語氣

text: those who take the sword will die by the sword
blank: all those who take the sword will ___ by the sword
gloss: 以暴制暴者終將自食惡果
usage: 現代英語常引用 live by the sword, die by the sword 形容訴諸暴力者終將死於暴力

text: washed his hands before the multitude
blank: he took water and ___ his hands before the multitude
usage: 現代英語極常用 wash your hands of something 表示撇清責任、不再過問某事

blank: May his ___ be on us and on our children
usage: 現代英語偶爾引用 his blood be on our heads 表示自願承擔罪責或後果

blank: they braided a crown of ___ and put it on his head
gloss: 荊棘冠冕，喻痛苦承擔或犧牲
usage: 現代英語常用 a crown of thorns 比喻某人肩負沉重痛苦的責任或犧牲，常見於媒體報導
